name: Indictments
overview: Scripture reveals that indictments often arose from accusations of blasphemy or disloyalty to earthly authorities, as seen in the charges against Jeremiah, who was accused of treason but acquitted, and the Hebrew captives Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, who were charged for defying the king's commands. Daniel faced similar accusations for his faithful prayers despite royal decrees. Jesus was indicted under charges of blasphemy and treason, reflecting the gravity of His claims and mission. These instances highlight the tension between divine truth and human authority, underscoring the cost of faithful witness.
